goal: Let wallet users set an explicit maximum fee rate independently of absolute fee limits
Prevent transaction creation and broadcast from conflating total fee caps with fee rates
agreement: Strong support for independently constraining total transaction cost and fee rate (murchandamus)
Approved after resolving unconfirmed input bump fee accounting in sendall (polespinasa)
Earlier objections on option scoping and startup checks were addressed (glozow, josibake)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because callers receive distinct error messages separating fee rate limits from fee caps
clarifies broadcast failures that previously lumped both constraints together

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because users get precise protection against high fee rates without improperly capping transaction size
resolves conflation between absolute fees and fee rates in transaction creation and fee bumping
